presentation.chiefComplaint: Unintentional weight loss and tiredness for 3 months
presentation.history: Has lost about 8 kg over 3 months without dieting, appetite reduced, constantly tired. Occasional night sweats, no fever. Bowel habit has become looser over the last 2 months, one episode of blood on the stool, no abdominal pain. No cough, no haemoptysis. Smoker for 30 years, about 15 cigarettes a day, drinks 2 beers most evenings. Mother had colon cancer at 62. No travel abroad, no known contact with tuberculosis. Otherwise no regular medication, no previous operations.
observations: BP 126/78, HR 84 regular, T 37.2°C, BMI 21 (was 25 a year ago)
Pale conjunctivae, no jaundice, no goitre
Abdomen soft, non-tender, no mass palpable, liver edge not enlarged
No palpable lymph nodes in neck, axillae or groins
Haemoglobin 10.4 g/dl with low MCV (point-of-care), CRP 14 mg/l, random glucose 5.6 mmol/l
